target_buyer.business_type: Independent auto parts retailer (Auto Value / All-Pro network)
target_buyer.existing_web_presence: None dedicated — Auto Value network page only
target_buyer.competitive_threat: 4 national chains in market (O'Reilly, AutoZone, Advance, NAPA)

usage.headings: Barlow Condensed — Bold, all-caps, wide letter-spacing (2-4px)
usage.body: Rajdhani — Regular 400 for body, Medium 500 for highlights

logo.description: 12-tooth gear in metallic silver gradient body with racing red radial hub center. 'PARTS' wordmark in bold condensed charcoal, 'REQUEST' in racing red, red underline accent. Tagline: 'ashtabula's local auto parts counter'. Two variants: icon-only gear and full wordmark.

taglines.primary: The parts you need, when you need them.
taglines.cta: Request Parts · Check Availability · Get a Quote

positioning: The online parts request portal for Lakeshore Auto Parts — giving Ashtabula's independent auto parts store a modern web presence to compete with national chains. Serves commercial garage accounts, DIY mechanics, and walk-in customers with 24/7 parts request capability, availability checking, and fast local delivery.

tone.voice: The counter guy who actually knows his stuff — direct, confident, no fluff. Blue-collar straightforward.
prefer: The parts you need, when you need them

design_language.description: Industrial auto parts aesthetic — gear motifs, red accent lines, silver/charcoal industrial palette, subtle grain texture, warm undertones. Analog warmth to differentiate from slick national chain sites.
ui_patterns: Red accent bars and underlines for section headers
Bold condensed all-caps headings with letter-spacing
Success green badges for 'In Stock' indicators
Warm gray background with white card surfaces
Gear icon as loading indicator and decorative element
signature_elements: Racing red accent underline below section headers
Charcoal header bar with white text
Metallic silver borders on input fields
Red CTA buttons with charcoal hover state
Subtle gear icon watermark on empty states

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Must feel like an independent local auto parts counter, not a sterile e-commerce site. The authenticity gap vs. national chains (O'Reilly, AutoZone) is the selling point. Use warm grays, red accents, industrial sans-serif typography.
key_features_needed: Parts request form (year/make/model, part description, contact info)
Delivery request option for local shops
Photo upload for 'describe the part you need'
differentiators: Local — Ashtabula's own auto parts store
Real — Not a corporate chain. Staff knows local vehicles and common failures.

cta_button_styles.primary: Racing red (#CC0000) background, white text (Barlow Condensed 600, all-caps), 8px border-radius
